title: The 10 Best Cordless Jobsite Fans
subtitle: Battery and hybrid fans for garages, attics and jobsites, ranked from live Amazon data.
intro: A cordless jobsite fan runs on the same batteries as your tools, so you can cool an attic, garage or job without an outlet. We ranked 10 best-sellers from DEWALT, FLEX, RIDGID, CRAFTSMAN, Milwaukee, RYOBI and value brands on rating, review volume and features (600 CFM or more, speed control, AC power and a weather rating).
data_source: Amazon product listings on the data_captured date. Prices, ratings and review counts change daily; check the listing before relying on a number.

avoid.name: 12" Battery Powered Cordless Floor Fan, Compatible with Dewalt 20V
avoid.flag: Claims 1,500 CFM from a 12-inch battery fan
avoid.verdict: A 12-inch DEWALT-battery fan that claims more airflow than DEWALT's and FLEX's own jobsite fans.
reasons: It claims 'up to 1500CFM' from a 12-inch fan, more than double DEWALT's 650 CFM DCE512B and well above FLEX's 1,100 CFM brushless fan.
No test standard or air speed is given to back the number.
It's rated 4.2 stars on 122 reviews; DEWALT's own fan is rated 4.8 on 8,409.

buyers_guide.q: How much airflow do I need?
buyers_guide.a: 200 CFM is personal cooling at a bench. 600 to 1,000 CFM moves air through a garage or jobsite room. Box fans that plug in move more, but battery fans go anywhere.
Hybrid fans (like the RIDGID, CRAFTSMAN CMCE001B and Paxwrenx) run on battery or AC, so you save the battery when an outlet's close.

buyers_guide.q: How long will a battery last?
buyers_guide.a: Small fans run for hours on low. DEWALT lists up to 4.5 hours for the DCE512B and CRAFTSMAN up to 8 hours on high for the CMCE001B, depending on the battery.
An IP54 rating means it handles dust and splashes, useful in a dusty jobsite or damp garage.

buyers_guide.q: Are the big CFM claims real?
buyers_guide.a: Tool-brand ratings are the most reliable. Treat no-name claims that beat DEWALT and FLEX by a wide margin with suspicion.
